# Keep the owning IMAP mailbox-string fix separate from later cleanup reversals

Entry 819 changes boxname from nsDependentCString(CreateAstring()) to adopting the allocated result and adds guards in several parser paths. Context-only entry 935 backs out the added cleanup and retains boxname.Adopt(CreateAstring()); its message reports new subfolder messages not showing. Accepted code still adopts the result directly. Preserve allocation ownership without promoting the reverted guard/advance changes as current rules. Exact regression conditions and Gecko string null-adoption behavior require discussion and paired-source verification; they were not established here.

Scope: mailnews/imap/src.
